status_summary: No NTIA review, request for comment, report or petition on online speech or Section 230 was found since 2025-01-20. Two parallel reviews by other bodies exist. Executive Order 14149, signed 2025-01-20, bars federal personnel from using federal resources to abridge protected speech and directs the Attorney General to investigate federal activity of the prior four years and report to the President with remedial recommendations; it gives no role to Commerce or NTIA. On 2025-02-20 the FTC opened a public inquiry, with comments due 2025-05-21, into whether technology platforms deny or degrade users' access because of their speech or affiliations and whether that conduct may be unlawful.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14149 is signed (published 2025-01-28, 90 FR 8243); it bars federal speech-restricting activity and directs the Attorney General to investigate the prior four years of federal activity and report to the President.
The FTC launches a public inquiry and request for information on technology platform censorship, with comments due 2025-05-21.

title: Review federal policy on online free speech and propose fixes for big tech censorship
